message: ストーカー禁酒法
Everyone in the Student Council came to Prier together.
We stand at the entrance, looking over the display menu.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so excited♪ I wonder what today's lunch special is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's see... An autumn-themed hamburg steak with grated momiji-oroshi radish, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Gulp...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It can't be helped, I suppose. If everyone is ordering the hamburg steak, I shall match you all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, ordering different things and trading bites with everyone is fun too, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, if my dear sister wishes it, I will order anything from a Manchu-Han Imperial Feast to plain salted rice.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「My wallet's in the dead of winter, so I'll just stick to tea, hot water, or ice water...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahahaha... A-At least call the hot water 'boiled water,' okay?」

name: Arden
message: 「Ahh, Pasta-chan...」
「Ahh, Pasta-chan...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoheh? There's a scruffy, bulky guy over there.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's wearing cat ears. Isn't he a total criminal?」

name: Arden
message: 「Pasta-chan, working so hard and admirably again today... Even that look is sexy. Huff, huff, huff.」
「Pasta-chan, working so hard and admirably again today... Even that look is sexy. Huff, huff, huff.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Espresso? That's way too much hassle, nya. You can just drink this, nya. Special tap water, 380 yen, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyanyanyaa!? Eat the vongole without leaving even the shells behind, nyaaa!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Which part of that work attitude is supposed to be admirable?」

name: Arden
message: 「Muhaa~, Pasta-chan's adorable outfit... C-Can I get a peek?」
「Muhaa~, Pasta-chan's adorable outfit... C-Can I get a peek?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyan!? W-What exactly is he trying to peek at?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with this guy, he's acting super suspicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「He's older than us, right? Maybe he's an alumnus, or a newly hired PE teacher?」

name: Ria
message: 「I haven't heard anything about a transfer, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「Excuse me? Unauthorized personnel are prohibited from entering this school, you know?」

name: Arden
message: 「Shut up, you old hag! Don't interrupt me while I'm adoring Pasta-chan, or I'll send you flying!」
「Shut up, you old hag! Don't interrupt me while I'm adoring Pasta-chan, or I'll send you flying!」

name: Ria
message: 「O-O-Old ha...」

name: Misa
message: 「...Unforgivable!!」

name: Helena
message: 「We're ending his life, right? I'll help.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Hey-nya! Shut up-nya! What are you guys doing-nya, loitering in front of the shop is a nuisance-nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Honestly, the ones who stare at the display case and agonize over what to get are always twisted-hearted cheapskates-nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「And then they eat the cheapest thing on the menu and start nitpicking about the seasoning or whatever-nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I get it! I totally get it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And on top of that, it's always those exact types who get inside and have a staring contest with the menu before ordering!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though it's the lunch rush and we're super busy, we can't turn over the tables because of them!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And yet they still ask crazy, out-of-line questions like, 'What's this? What's that? Which one tastes the best? How much of a discount will you give me?'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Taste is a matter of personal preference, so there's no way to answer that!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「*Sniff*, I understand that feeling way too well-nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, there, don't cry. You can't let the customers see your tears, okay? Here's a handkerchief.」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're a good one-nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're quite the admirable woman yourself!」
A friendship transcending species blossomed between Nanaka and Pasta.

name: Arden
message: 「That's just complaining, isn't it.」
「That's just complaining, isn't it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Say that, and it's all over.」

name: Arden
message: 「Close one, close one... I was so captivated by Pasta-chan that I lost sight of the heart of the matter.」
「Close one, close one... I was so captivated by Pasta-chan that I lost sight of the heart of the matter.」

name: Arden
message: 「Staying in a cesspool swirling with complaints and dissatisfaction like this is gonna make Pasta-chan sick.」
「Staying in a cesspool swirling with complaints and dissatisfaction like this is gonna make Pasta-chan sick.」

name: Arden
message: 「Alright... Elope with me! We'll hold a wedding ceremony with just the two of us!」
「Alright... Elope with me! We'll hold a wedding ceremony with just the two of us!」

name: Arden
message: 「And we'll live in a detached house with a red roof, white walls, and a yard, and have three kids. Let's get a big dog too!」
「And we'll live in a detached house with a red roof, white walls, and a yard, and have three kids. Let's get a big dog too!」

name: Misa
message: 「How lovely... Could you possibly be Pasta-san's boyfriend?」

name: Pasta
message: 「He's a stalker, nya. He's Arden the ped○phile, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「I-I'm not a pervert! I'm just passionate!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's one way to put it.」

name: Pasta
message: 「He's a clingy closet pervert, nya.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-So merciless.」

name: Arden
message: 「D-Dammit! This is all your guys' fault!!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Us? No matter how you look at it, you're just taking it out on us.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Guys who shift blame onto others are small fry, nya. There's no food to spare for a man like that, nya, get lost somewhere, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「P-Pasta-chan, I--」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta is working, nya! Can't you tell it's a nuisance when you come around, nya!?」

name: Arden
message: 「I-I'm sorry~~」

name: Arden
message: 「I'm gonna go delinquent! I'm gonna drown my sorrows in booze!」

name: Arden
message: 「Wait, I don't have any money, so from some moped around here, I'll siphon out the (rest omitted)」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heeeey, you'd better stay away from two-strokes, man?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Pasta, shouldn't you sugarcoat your words a little more?」

name: Pasta
message: 「There's no need to be considerate of someone like him, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「He's a real pain too, nya. Acting all big like he's Pasta's boyfriend.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way, Pasta-san actually has a boyfriend!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wrong, nya! Pasta's steady is a much more gallant and cool Bylous-nyama, nya.」

name: Helena
message: 「Bylous...」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Pasta-san... Don't tell me you're two-timing!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「What's that, nya? Don't tell me you don't even have a single boyfriend, nya?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's wrong with that? Do you have a problem with me?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyahmph, not really~」

name: Misa
message: 「Mm... Mmmmuuu--! Somehow, I feel like I totally lost.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Look, your friends are already seated, nya. Hurry up and scarf down your feed, nya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom nom nom♪ Apparently, the proper name for hamburg is hamburg steak.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-Whaaat!? Then doesn't that mean it's the same thing as beefsteak!!」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm. Maybe the only thing similar is the raw ingredients?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's a beef-pork blend!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Loro-chan. She's already eating her hamburg all by herself ahead of us.」

name: Helena
message: 「Can't we just say Lolotte-chan already won and leave it at that?」
